reasons.text: The label photo for this claim is the same image (same sha256) as a photo on another claim in the program, so the claim must be flagged for review.
The label photo is legible and shows REV 12 Kids Bike, a recalled model, so the model is confirmed even though the typed model reads REV 16 Kids Bike (both are recalled).

The typed serial ET2224893099 is in a recalled range, but the label photo's serial reads QQ52456269, which does not match the typed serial and was not in the recalled range check from the label. The mismatch needs review together with the duplicate.
The purchase is at REI on 2024-04-04, inside the sale window, and no receipt is required; the date code 2022 is in the recalled range.
